meta.name: fix-what-i-pointed-at
meta.description: Pick up the bugs a human flagged by pointing at them in the running app, each arriving with the element, the note they typed, and the source file and line. Use when the user says they marked or flagged something, when starting a session on an app someone has been clicking through, when a designer or PM has left feedback in the UI, or when the user describes a problem as "that button there" without saying which file.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 指着跑起来的界面圈出问题,直接拿到对应文件和行号去修
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果设计师或产品在界面上留了一堆标注,你要逐个找出是哪个文件哪一行。
copy.tagline_en: Point at a problem in the running app and get the exact file and line to fix.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if designers or PMs left UI notes and you must trace each one to a file and line.

howto.what: Claude 会读取你在运行中的 App 里点选并写下备注的 bug 标记——每条带着元素、你的说明和出处文件与行号;它打开对应代码位置去改,在 App 里验证后再把该标记标为已解决。
howto.when: 当你说自己标记了某处问题、在一个别人刚点过的 App 上开始会话,或设计师、PM 在界面里留了反馈时接管。

say.text: 我标记了几个问题,先读一下有哪些。
把 Checkout 那条标记修掉,并在 App 里验证。
say.note: 打开对应文件行号,改完后验证。

say.text: 这条先不修,说明原因后保持未解决。

howto.what_en: Claude reads the bug marks you placed by pointing and typing in the running app — each carries the element, your note, and the file:line. It opens that source, fixes it, verifies in the app, then resolves the mark.
howto.when_en: Use when the user says they marked or flagged something, when starting a session on an app someone has been clicking through, or when a designer or PM left feedback in the UI.

say_en.text: I flagged a few things — read the marks.
Fix the Checkout mark and verify it in the app.
say_en.note: Opens the file:line and checks the fix.

say_en.text: Don't fix this one; say why and leave it unresolved.
say_en.note: The mark stays open with a reason.
